rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Organizes files into categorized directories using intelligent extension-based classification across 12+ file types. Features SHA-256 hash-based duplicate detection, dry-run preview mode for risk-free planning, and full rollback/undo functionality. Implements multi-layer path validation with TOCTOU mitigation, symbolic link restrictions, and reserved name blocking for secure file operations.
